title: Durable orchestrator messaging and chat synchronization
goal: Give every repository-scoped head orchestrator a durable worker-note inbox and a truthful, acknowledged notification outbox for registered chat and IDE destinations.
approved: yes @ 2026-08-21 (chat: Daniel confirmed synchronized chat notifications, a durable orchestrator, and worker notes)

meta.focus: durable worker-to-orchestrator notes, repository isolation, acknowledged chat/IDE delivery, and an honest operator UI

spine.title: Durable control plane
spine.summary: Persist repository-scoped messages, notes, delivery state, retries, and acknowledgements outside React memory.

spine.title: Orchestrator surfaces
spine.summary: Expose worker notes and delivery truth on the head orchestrator without replacing the existing board.

spine.title: Connector boundary and proof
spine.summary: Register destinations explicitly and prove that failures remain visible instead of being reported as sent.

vertebrae.title: Append-only control-plane ledger
vertebrae.notes: Immutable message events with idempotency, delivery claims, bounded retries, acknowledgement, and restart recovery. Fully qualified repository/plan/node/worker scope is mandatory.

checklist.text: Persist worker notes and orchestrator messages in an append-only local ledger
Derive QUEUED, CLAIMED, DELIVERED, ACKNOWLEDGED and DEAD_LETTER states from durable events
Reject missing repository scope and deduplicate repeated idempotency keys

vertebrae.title: Tauri command and permission boundary
vertebrae.notes: Narrow commands only. No arbitrary shell command or arbitrary session injection from the webview.

checklist.text: Expose scoped post, snapshot, claim, result and acknowledgement commands
Grant only the named control-plane commands to the main window

vertebrae.title: Typed frontend control-plane client
vertebrae.notes: Tauri invoke client plus a deterministic browser fallback for headless UI verification.

checklist.text: Map the Rust snapshot and commands into strict TypeScript types
Keep browser test fallback repository-scoped and idempotent

vertebrae.title: Worker notes and orchestrator inbox
vertebrae.notes: A worker card opens a scoped note composer/history. The head shows pending notes and delivery state. Failed or unregistered destinations remain visibly unsent.

checklist.text: Worker cards open a fully scoped notes panel and can append a note

vertebrae.title: Destination registry, retries and end-to-end proof
vertebrae.notes: The local outbox is canonical. Registered transports can claim deliveries and must report results. Stable Codex exec-session resume can be an opt-in adapter; experimental app-server injection is capability-gated and never assumed.
